content: The challenges associated with the Medication Regimen (MR) extraction task include understanding the spontaneous dialog with clinical vocabulary and understanding the relationship between different entities as the discussion can contain multiple medications and dosages (e.g. doctor revising a dosage or reviewing all the current medications).
